errors.text: The hypothesis predicts negligible HCP fraction, whereas the target reports that HCP atom fraction increases with temperature and treats HCP counting as a key structural indicator.
It claims that temperatures above 900 K prevent dislocation annihilation, contradicting the target's significant reduction in dislocation density at 900–1200 K.

It invokes grain-boundary-mediated deformation in an initially single-crystal coating without establishing formation of actual grain boundaries; interface-mediated deformation is possible but is not demonstrated.
The proposed temperature series omits the essential 300 K and 600 K controls, preventing direct verification of the mechanical-annealing regime and the modulus maximum at 600 K.
